title: IRS collection financial statement (Form 433-B) for a business
use_when: Use when a corporation, partnership or LLC that owes the IRS must complete Form 433-B; use the Form 433-A list for an individual or sole proprietor, and the offer in compromise list for Form 433-B (OIC).
note: Built from Form 433-B (Rev. 6-2026). The form asks for copies of applicable documents in Section 3; the rest of the documents below are the verification the IRS says it may ask for after review. It does not cover the owners' personal statements (Form 433-A), state tax agencies, or which collection alternative the business qualifies for.

f433b.name: IRS Form 433-B, Collection Information Statement for Businesses (Rev. 6-2026)

situations.ecommerce: Does the business make internet sales or accept credit cards or other electronic payments?
situations.payroll-provider: Does the business use a payroll service provider or reporting agent?
situations.lawsuit: Is the business a party to a lawsuit?
situations.bankruptcy: Has the business ever filed bankruptcy?
situations.related-loans: Do any officers, partners, employees or other related parties owe money to the business?
situations.transfers: In the last 10 years, did the business transfer any asset for less than full value?
situations.affiliates: Does the business have subsidiaries, a parent company or other business affiliations?
situations.income-change: Does the business expect its income to go up or down?
situations.federal-contractor: Is the business a federal government contractor?
situations.safe: Does the business have a safe on its premises or a safe deposit box?
situations.digital-assets: Does the business own any cryptocurrency, NFTs, smart contracts or other digital assets?
situations.real-property: Does the business own, lease or rent any real property or land contracts?
situations.vehicles: Does the business own or lease vehicles, boats, trailers or mobile homes?

items.label: Business name, addresses, county, phone, EIN, entity type, date established and website
items.detail: Form 433-B lines 1a-2c and 1f. For an LLC, include the number of members. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Number of employees, monthly gross payroll, tax deposit frequency and whether the business uses EFTPS
items.detail: Form 433-B lines 3a-3d.

items.label: Payment processors and credit card merchant accounts, with account numbers and issuing banks
items.detail: Form 433-B lines 4-6c. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: For each partner, officer, LLC member and major shareholder: name, title, home address, phones, taxpayer identification number, ownership percentage, annual salary or draw, and whether responsible for depositing payroll taxes
items.detail: Form 433-B Section 2, lines 7a-7d. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Payroll service provider or reporting agent name, address and effective dates
items.detail: Form 433-B line 8 (Section 3: attach copies of all applicable documents).

items.label: Lawsuit details and documents: court location, representation, docket or case number, amount, expected completion date and subject
items.detail: Form 433-B line 9 (Section 3: attach copies of all applicable documents).

items.label: Bankruptcy documents: filing, dismissal and discharge dates, petition number and district
items.detail: Form 433-B line 10 (Section 3: attach copies of all applicable documents).

items.label: Loans to related parties: name, address, loan date, current balance, payment date and amount
items.detail: Form 433-B line 11 (Section 3: attach copies of all applicable documents).

items.label: Assets transferred for less than full value in the last 10 years: value, date and recipient
items.detail: Form 433-B line 12 (Section 3: attach copies of all applicable documents).

items.label: Names, addresses and EINs of related businesses
items.detail: Form 433-B line 13.

items.label: Explanation of the expected income increase or decrease, how much and when
items.detail: Form 433-B line 14.

items.label: Federal government contracts
items.detail: Form 433-B line 15 says to include federal contracts with accounts and notes receivable on line 18.

items.label: Cash on hand not in a bank
items.detail: Form 433-B line 16a.

items.label: Safe and safe deposit box details, with a list of contents and their value
items.detail: Form 433-B line 16b: location, box number and value; attach list of contents.

items.label: List of every business bank account, with institution, account number and current balance
items.detail: Form 433-B line 17: checking, savings, money market, online and mobile (e.g., PayPal) accounts and stored value cards. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Bank and investment statements
items.detail: Listed in the verification note after the Form 433-B signature line. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Accounts and notes receivable, including e-payment receivables, factoring, contracts and government grants
items.detail: Form 433-B line 18: status, date due, invoice or contract number and amount due; list contracts awarded but not started.

items.label: Investments with current value, any loan balance and whether used as loan collateral
items.detail: Form 433-B line 19.

items.label: List of digital assets with units, location, account number, U.S. dollar value and any loan, plus a statement of each virtual currency's public key
items.detail: Form 433-B line 20, including the names of everyone with access to the private keys or wallets. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Lines of credit and credit cards: credit limit, amount owed and available credit
items.detail: Form 433-B line 21. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Real property and land contracts: description, location, purchase or lease date, fair market value, loan balance, monthly payment and lender, lessor or landlord
items.detail: Form 433-B line 22.

items.label: Vehicles: year, make and model, mileage, plate number, VIN, value, loan balance, monthly payment and lender or lessor
items.detail: Form 433-B line 23.

items.label: Machinery, equipment, inventory and intangible assets (licenses, patents, domain names, trademarks, software, goodwill) with values and loans
items.detail: Form 433-B line 24.

items.label: Other business liabilities, notes and judgments: creditor, secured or unsecured, balance, final payment date and payment amount
items.detail: Form 433-B line 25.

items.label: Loan statements and financing statements
items.detail: Listed in the verification note after the Form 433-B signature line.

items.label: Profit and loss statement for the prior 3, 6, 9 or 12 months
items.detail: Form 433-B Section 5 uses that period to find average monthly income and expenses (lines 26-50); profit and loss statements are listed in the verification note.

items.label: Copies of previously filed business income tax returns
items.detail: Listed in the verification note after the Form 433-B signature line.

items.label: Bills or statements for recurring expenses: rent, utilities, insurance, supplies, vehicle costs and current taxes
items.detail: Form 433-B lines 37-47; bills or statements for recurring expenses are listed in the verification note.

items.label: Name and title of the officer, partner or LLC member who will sign
items.detail: Form 433-B certification.
